title: Ancient Amulets
description: Adds artifacts that will strengthen your character!
body:
## Description
Are you having a hard time destroying the Ender Dragon? Then you are in the right place! The "Ancient Amulets" data pack will add 4 new amulets that will make your character stronger in battles with players or mobs!

## How to use amulets?
To activate an amulet, take it in your main hand!

## How to get an amulet?
To find an amulet, you need to locate the Well of Amulets! This structure appears in forests, deserts, plains, taiga, jungles, savannas, swamps, and snowy plains.

## Characteristics of amulets
Each amulet has two parameters: strength and duration of the effect.
